blocks.x: A working build of Cyber & Zero-Trust for Care Management & Population Health: the operating context that shapes it, the services sequenced through the method, and the deltas we commit to.

Care management succeeds on precision targeting and timely intervention: identifying rising-risk members, coordinating across providers, and proving quality outcomes. It is a data-discipline business — and the data discipline is usually the missing part.

items: Care teams share sensitive data across vendors; controls lag.
Claims, clinical, SDOH and engagement data siloed; risk stratification runs on claims only.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery, Identity & Access Modernization, Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Risk stratification, Care outreach and scheduling, Program matching) on Dataq Sentinel and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — HIPAA among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Secure at the control plane: posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
Secure the models themselves: prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
Assume breach, plan recovery: resilience engineered, rehearsed and measured.
Vendor access governed with monitoring (coordination secure)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Healthcare & Life Sciences level this capability reads as: IEC 80001-informed zoning for legacy devices with monitoring (unmanaged device surface made visible and controlled). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Programs run on the fixed rhythm below, chosen so progress is legible from week one. Weeks 1–2 measure and sign the baseline with your team; nothing builds against an unsigned number. Weeks 3–8 prove the pattern on deliberately bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — under a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, closing with a measured delta against the baseline. Every gate is pass, stop or redirect, in writing.
